full_judgment: 4. Defendant No.1, (herein petitioner) contested the suit by filing written statement denying all material allegations made in the plaint contending inter alia that the aforesaid properties were government khas land and one Maulvi Nurul Islam took settlement of some land from the government. The defendants purchased the said land from the successor of Nurul Islam. The plaintiff is claiming the property by virtue of wrong Kabala. The plaintiff or his predecessor had no right, title and interest in the suit land thereby the suit is liable to be dismissed.
